title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 1-4 (Prakriti, Vikriti, Vidya, Sarvabhuta Hitaprada)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 1 to 4: Prakriti, Vikriti, Vidya, Sarvabhuta Hitaprada, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 1 to 4 with meaning
caption: Names 1 to 4 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 1 to 4**: **Prakriti, Vikriti, Vidya, Sarvabhuta Hitaprada**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Prakriti, Vikriti, Vidya, Sarvabhuta Hitaprada.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Prakriti** means **Primal Nature**. Lakshmi as the primal energy from which creation unfolds.
**Vikriti** means **Manifold Forms**. The one Goddess appears in many forms: wealth, grain, courage, knowledge.
**Vidya** means **Knowledge**. True wealth includes wisdom; knowledge is her form too.

sections.h: Sarvabhuta Hitaprada: Giver of welfare to all beings
p: **Sarvabhuta Hitaprada** means **Giver of welfare to all beings**. Her grace is not only for the rich; it is for every being.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
